newsitem.title: USA: U.S. HEADLINE STOCKS - ISSUES TO WATCH - AUGUST 8.
newsitem.headline: U.S. HEADLINE STOCKS - ISSUES TO WATCH - AUGUST 8.

text.p: -- America Online reported a fourth quarter loss of $0.12 per share, including what it called timing adjustments made after talking with the Securities and Exchange Commission. Before these adjustments, AOL posted a profit of $0.09 per shares compared to last year's fourth quarter earnings of $0.14 per share and a First Call consensus estimate of $0.07 per share. The stock closed at 71.

-- Electronic Data Systems posted a second quarter profit of $0.05 per share, including $0.35 per share in charges, versus a loss of $0.67 per share, including $1.18 per share in charges. EDS said it expected an erosion of revenues and earnings to deflate 1997 financial results to a range of $1.90 and $2.00 per share. The stock closed at 43-1/16.

-- Petsmart said it expected to report second quarter net income, excluding merger and restructuring charges, in the range of $0.02 to $0.04 per share, below the Wall Street consensus estimate. The stock closed at 11-12/16.
-- A Greenway Partners affliate said it was starting an $18 a share cash tender offer for shares of Outboard Marine Corp starting August 8. The stock closed at 16-5/16.
-- Cymer Inc set a two-for-one stock split payable on September 11. Its stock closed at 77-7/16 then jumped as high as 80-1/4 in after-hours trading.
